actual: Current unified implementation has not yet introduced the shared Phase 1 guard layer for the future unified branch; current paths may still call HMM/SQL/data readiness through separate service seams.
closure_requirements: F2M-03 selection readiness: HMM preset missing, metadata-only preset, non-numeric coefficient, empty coefficient, no trade-date coverage, empty/missing sector mapping all fail fast with structured context and no default coefficients.

F2M-03 SQL/data guard: malformed ts_code values including timestamp-mixed symbols are rejected before any kline/reference-price SQL in qe_data_service, realtime_factor_data_loader, and strategy_package.selection_artifact.
F2M-03 bulk query guard: kline_daily_raw, adj_factor, and selection reference-price queries are chunked with source/correlation logging and do not issue one unbounded full-market query.

F2M-03 prepare-window reuse: LocalSim and MiniQMT bindings that fan out the same runtime release/package/date/data_source reuse one DailySelectionEvidence selection result or one cached failure within a scheduler run.
BUG-181/193/199/202 inheritance evidence is recorded in the Phase 1 validation history; any non-applicable inherited item must be marked with evidence rather than omitted.

Run and record required verification plans: l0, paper_v2_backend, paper_v2_l3, qe_read_l3, validation_center_backend, validation_module_registry_l0, or explicitly record unrelated/baseline blockers with rerun evidence.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized through the standard workflow; no production DB/DDL, production backend restart, or runtime activation is performed by this issue.
